title: Global Health Security Preparedness: A Cross-National Assessment of Infectious Disease Burden and Response Capacity
description: Constructed a composite Health Security Preparedness Index (HSPI) across 164 countries by normalizing workforce, statistical infrastructure, and health expenditure indicators alongside TB incidence.

title: One Health Resistome Profiling of Salmonella enterica Across Human, Animal, Food, and Environmental Sources
description: Comparative genomic analysis of 320 S. enterica genomes curated from NCBI Pathogen Detection portal to characterize resistance determinants using AMRFinderPlus and hAMRonize.

title: One Health Comparative Genomics of Escherichia coli Isolates across Nine Nations (2018–2022)
description: Reproducible genomic surveillance workflow tracing regional AMR burden, emerging genetic determinants, and transmission across environmental and host contexts.

title: Genomic Insights Into SARS-CoV-2: Mutation Patterns and Public Health Implications
description: Processing raw SARS-CoV-2 sequencing data via nf-core/viralrecon workflow including quality control, alignment, variant calling, and consensus genome generation.

title: Assessing HIV Awareness, Prevention Practices, and Stigma in Nigeria
description: Analyzed the 2018 Nigeria Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) datasets using descriptive and inferential statistics to evaluate demographic predictors of HIV stigma.
